t: Bill Simmons scores massive sale as Spotify buys his publication, The Ringer, for nearly $200 million
s: February 12, 2020 - According to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Wednesday, Spotify could pay out nearly $200 million in cash over the next few years to acquire The Ringer, an online publication for sports and pop culture.

t: Spotify is buying Bill Simmons’s The Ringer to boost its podcast business
s: February 5, 2020 - Spotify is making yet another big-budget purchase aimed at getting a lead in the growing podcast industry: The streaming music company has agreed to a deal to purchase The Ringer, the podcast-centric media company run and owned by Bill Simmons.

t: Spotify Sale Mints The Ringer’s Bill Simmons As Podcasting’s First Big-Money Superstar
s: June 4, 2020 - Simmons made the deal right before the pandemic, when the industry began to slump and ad revenue plummeted across all media. Very few podcasts sit behind a paywall, leaving them dependent almost entirely by commercials, including, including The Ringer’s, with even the top shows losing as much as 15% of that income, according to one industry expert.

t: r/billsimmons on Reddit: Late submission for worst NBA contract: Spotify paying $200M for non-exclusive rights to The Ringer Podcast Network
s: March 21, 2023 - Given the Music Industry basically has them by the balls that they will never make money on streaming music, this was probably the only way they could make a profit in the long run. Reminder that the Spotify CEO described buying the ringer as “buying the new ESPN”.

t: Spotify needed a huge podcast, and it just bought one of the biggest | The Verge
s: February 5, 2020 - Spotify announced the acquisition of The Ringer, a media company with a fledgling podcast operation. The purchase builds on its prior deals with Gimlet Media, Parcast, and Anchor, along with its other original programs.
